en.t: I was so frightened that I stood there dumbfounded.

units.source_text: 不仅这样，伴随着培卟和查喀的笑声，我从嘎尔家的客厅落荒而逃。

en.t: Not only that, with Pepp and Chuck laughing behind me, I fled in panic from Gael's parlor.

units.source_text: 那天晚上天色阴郁，一颗星星都找不到。

en.t: That night the sky was gloomy, and not a single star could be found.

units.source_text: 我一边在漆黑中往家里走，一路边在路上呕吐不止，

en.t: As I walked home through the pitch darkness, I kept vomiting along the road,

units.source_text: 透过微弱的夜光，依稀能看到吐出的东西是白色的。

en.t: and in the faint night light I could dimly see that what I had thrown up was white.
